entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this piece of junk VeloBand sensor. It's useless and I want my money back immediately.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It doesn't matter why! It's not what I wanted. I've had it for about a month and it's just been sitting here. Are you going to process my return or are you going to waste my time with a bunch of questions?
I understand you'd like to get this resolved quickly. I just need to pull up your order to verify the purchase date. Do you have the order number handy?
Ugh, fine. It's VF88602. Now hurry up. This is already taking way too long.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered on December 15th, which was 35 days ago.

So what? Are you going to tell me it's too late now? This is unbelievable! If you don't give me my money back, I'm going to post reviews on every single website about your garbage products and terrible service. Get me your manager, now!
Sir, I understand your frustration, but there's no need for that. I've just checked the return policy for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. You are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh. It's... it's 90 days? So you can actually process the return?

Yes, absolutely. Since it was delivered 35 days ago, you're eligible for a full refund to your original payment method. I am generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email address we have on file. Do you have access to that?
Yeah, I have it. I'll check for it later. So I just print it and ship it back?
That's correct. Just attach the label to the box and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
